variants.display_name: Stannis Baratheon — The One True King
Jon Snow — Battle of the Bastards

abilities.name: Come With Me And Take This City
abilities.exact_visible_text: Stannis deals 155% ATK Physical Damage to a single enemy and spawns 1 random Power-Up. He then TAUNTS enemies with a +35% Durability Buff for 2 turns.

abilities.name: I Will Not Retreat II
abilities.exact_visible_text: Stannis begins the battle with +50% Stamina. When any Power-Up is destroyed while he's TAUNTING, he REMOVES 1 Buff from all enemies.

abilities.name: For The True King
abilities.exact_visible_text: Criston gains a +2% DEF Buff for each BIRTHRIGHT he has, for 4 turns. He then strikes a single enemy for 80% DEF Physical Damage.

abilities.name: The Kingmaker II
abilities.exact_visible_text: Anytime Criston is struck by an enemy Skill, he strikes that enemy for +100% ATK Physical Damage and grants all allies +2 BIRTHRIGHT.

abilities.name: I Send You To Glory II
abilities.exact_visible_text: Criston begins combat with +8 BIRTHRIGHT and +75% Stamina. When an enemy is defeated, Criston TAUNTS the enemy team for 4 turns.

abilities.name: You Against Me
abilities.exact_visible_text: Jon strikes an enemy for 25% ATK Physical Damage. He follows up this attack with 3 bonus strikes that each do 50% ATK Physical Damage and deal triple damage if the target is BRITTLE.

abilities.name: Charge The Enemy
abilities.exact_visible_text: At the start of each turn, any BRITTLE enemy suffers an indefinite -5% ATK Debuff.

abilities.name: Avenge The Fallen
abilities.exact_visible_text: When an ally is defeated, the enemy who dealt the final blow is afflicted with 1 ICE, and Jon gains +25% Stamina.
